corrections.text: The article's Overview section describes a GitHub tracking-issue comment confirming the nightly-2026-11-14 cutover date and PR #162848 as coming 'from Beránek's GitHub account, Kobzol.' None of the article's cited sources establishes that the GitHub user Kobzol is Jakub Beránek, the Rust Blog post's named author; the comment is correctly attributed to the GitHub user Kobzol, and the date and PR number it confirms are accurate, but the identification of that account as belonging to Beránek is unsourced.
